card.name: Openers just before a quoted or specified item
card.fires_on: Small opening words or marks (an open parenthesis, quote mark, "the", "with") that come right before a named item, quantity or title. Mostly in recipes, quotes and explanatory web text.

modes.label: Open bracket or quote
modes.description: An opening parenthesis or quotation mark just before a size, number or coined term.

modes.label: Small word before a noun phrase
modes.description: "the", "with" or "The" starting a title, quotation or named system.

modes.label: Start of a list item
modes.description: A period or word that starts the next term in a list of definitions or ingredients.
